guide: GPUI Kit Design Guides @ 944803984cf0 (design review, accessibility, interaction states, feedback/overlays, data-heavy, interface language)
method: Real retained data on the live origin, candidate assets substituted by GET interception (web.html, web.js, web.css, project.js, project.css, icons.js, ui.js, work*, code-review*). Read-only: no non-GET request; dialogs opened then dismissed. The Cancel/Pause wording check stubbed one GET response in-page (controls advertised) and blocked any non-GET.
recorded_deviations: Navigation to console routes is a link (rail destinations and run tabs are <a href> with in-page plain-click navigation); the guide's Button/Action for internal navigation would lose new-tab and history.
No OS menus or window chrome; the web shell supplies the rail, top bar and account menu.
Mobile touch targets stay at 44px (min-height 2.75rem at <=60rem).

Page-header command keeps `primary` (kiln.web.visual_design requires one primary action per view): project page `Run latest…` opens the start form; the guide would use a default Button for a command that only opens a form. Inside the run-control dialog primary stays on the commit (danger for Cancel run).

findings: Rail destinations were <button data-page>: navigation without href (no open in new tab/history), contrary to the recorded web deviation.
Selected rail item had a transparent row; selection should be the item's own surface (guide: selected fill/weight, no edge bar).
Account menu and drawer triggers showed no persistent open state while their popup was shown (only a chevron turn).
Raw colours outside the theme layer: rgb scrim in dialog::backdrop and the drawer backdrop, rgb inset shadow on the search trigger, raw hex border on the terminal panel.
Disclosure summaries and button rows used the pointing-hand cursor; the guide reserves it for links.
Keyboard: Ctrl K, Escape-to-trigger on account menu and drawer, skip link and focus ring verified; unchanged.
fixes: web.html: 18 rail destinations are <a data-page href>; web.js keeps hrefs equal to navigate(patch) and handles plain clicks in-page; CSS selectors moved from `.app-navigation button` to `.app-navigation a`.
web.css: selected rail row gets --list-active fill and 650 weight; the acid-yellow icon tile is kept (documented).
web.css: button.account-button[aria-expanded=true] and #app-menu-toggle[aria-expanded=true] keep a --list-active fill and --list-active-border.

web.css: new --overlay token (scrim) used by dialog::backdrop and the drawer backdrop; search trigger inset shadow removed; terminal border uses its --border token. Remaining hex/rgb are theme-token definitions only.
web.css: summary cursor default; cursor:pointer removed from source-entry buttons, nav/log/overview/run-filter summaries.

findings: Title `Confirm cancel run`, commit `Confirm cancel`, dismiss `Keep unchanged`: generic, no object named.
Reruns: title without object, commit `Create new run`, and the commit kept danger styling for non-destructive reruns.
Opening buttons lacked the ellipsis for commands that open a dialog.
Dialog had no alertdialog role for a consequential confirmation.
fixes: Cancel: `Cancel run "<project label>"?` / `Cancel run` (danger) / `Keep running` (`Keep queued` for queued work).
Pause: `Pause run "<label>"?` / `Pause run` / `Keep running`; Resume: `Resume run "<label>"?` / `Resume run` / `Keep paused`.

Reruns: `Rerun "<label>" at the exact revision?` / `Rerun`; `Run "<label>" on the latest admitted reference?` / `Run latest`; `Retry failed nodes of "<label>"?` / `Retry failed nodes`; dismiss `Cancel`; commit primary.
Exact facts, freshness checks, warning body, focus on the safe dismissal and payloads unchanged; role=alertdialog added.
Openers: `Cancel run…`, `Rerun…` (aria-label `Rerun exact revision…`), `Pause run…`, `Resume run…`, `Rerun exact revision…`, `Run latest admitted reference…`, `Retry known failed nodes…`.
control-dialog.verified: Escape and the dismiss button close the dialog and return focus to the opening button (header-rerun, rerun-latest, rerun-failed, header-cancel, control-pause); no non-GET was sent.

findings: Title `CI overview` repeated the `Continuous integration` eyebrow and differed from the rail label `Overview`.
Run-count chip said `Succeeded` while every other surface says `Passed`.
Attention cards drew a danger leading edge on top of the Failed pill: six competing red edges (emphasis budget, one-sided border).
Row actions were Logs, Pipeline on cards but Pipeline, Logs in the project table (unstable lanes).
Side links `Open workers` / `View all activity` restated the card context.
fixes: Title `Overview`.
Chip label `Passed`.
Attention-card and project-card leading status edges removed.
Project table actions ordered Logs, Pipeline.
Links `All workers`, `All activity`.

findings: Project cards repeated health as a coloured leading edge beside the health pill.
Start form commit is primary (default commit of a form; allowed).
fixes: Leading health edges removed (pill and text carry health).

findings: Header `Run latest` opens the start form but had no ellipsis and its tooltip claimed a separate confirmation.
Health card drew a status-coloured leading edge beside the pill and coloured headline.
Run history actions were Pipeline, Logs while last-run tiles were Logs, Pipeline.
`All runs for this project` restated the card context.
fixes: `Run latest…` (primary per recorded deviation); tooltip states it opens the start form and nothing dispatches until submit; empty-state copy matches.
Leading health edge removed.
Actions ordered Logs, Pipeline.
Link `All runs`.

findings: Selected run rows (table and stacked), worker/COB/receipt choices and source entries used a 3px leading bar as the selection marker.
Table row hover and selection used the same fill (--muted == --list-active), so the bar was the only distinction.
Run tabs were buttons although they change the `view` route.
fixes: Selection is the row's own surface: --list-active fill plus a full --list-active-border boundary; hover uses --list-hover; COB choices no longer change border on hover.
Run tabs are <a data-view href> links with aria-current; 40px desktop / 44px touch.

findings: Pipeline, Logs, Artifacts, Tests & coverage, Reviews, Compare & flaky, Activity, Evidence reviewed with real data: states (empty/unavailable/loading) explicit, About disclosures hold boundary copy; no further guide violations found beyond shared selection/link fixes.
fixes: Shared fixes above (tabs as links, selection surfaces, cursor).

findings: Metric tiles inside the snapshot panel carried their own shadow (card-in-card elevation).
fixes: Inventory tiles keep a hairline boundary, no shadow.

findings: No violations beyond shared fixes; entries lead with method, target and decision.
